title: Luxuriously Sweet Middle Eastern Milk Fatteh
description: A buttery and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring sweetened condensed milk, served in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the pita bread until crispy and break into pieces.
In a large cataplana vessel, combine the toasted pita bread, melted score fat, and unsalted butter.
Drizzle the chilled sweetened condensed milk over the pita bread mixture.
Sprinkle the rose water, cardamom powder, and chopped pistachios over the top.
Bake the fatteh in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the luxuriously sweet Middle Eastern milk fatteh warm and enjoy.
